props.title: Why Yoga Feels So Good During Pregnancy
props.subtitle: From mindfulness and body awareness to Nadi Shodana – how yoga gently accompanies you through a physically and emotionally intense phase of life and prepares you for birth.
props.imageAlt: Clay figure of a pregnant woman

props.content:
The time of pregnancy and the preparation for birth are a very special phase of life for many women. The shifts and changes – whether in your personal environment or in all other areas of life – are all-encompassing. Your own body visibly moves into the centre, and the changes are enormous not only on a physical level but especially on an emotional one.

A good time to care lovingly for yourself

Now is a good time to care well and lovingly for your own body. Your strength flows into the depth of the feminine, into "being a woman" and into the woman's inherent creative power.

Giving birth is creative power made manifest!

What yoga has to offer from its age-old tradition

To discover this and to experience good preparation for birth, yoga has much to offer from its age-old tradition:

  • The deep, yogic belly breathing helps to supply your body and the baby well with oxygen and life energy.
  • Relaxation, so important for this time and for the birth, is essential.
  • Many asanas are birthing positions and can already be practised.
  • The mental preparation for a positive and self-determined course of birth is a supporting pillar of yogic birth preparation.

Last but not least, sung mantra help to open the heart and cleanse all energy channels. Why not simply give it a try!

props.title: Accompany Your Pregnancy with Yoga
props.text: Would you like to prepare mindfully for birth and connect lovingly with your body? I would be glad to accompany you on this path.
